reason: I want to make the removable cover, and forming graded regolith in the channel-cover mold looks like the first step.
expectation: The furnace will produce cover pieces for the water line, though they may still need installing.

alternatives.reason: Cleaning the trough also serves a goal, but I want to secure the water line first.
Storing seed potatoes looks useful too, but I chose the cover first.

effect: The mold produced the cover pieces I expected, so I can fit them to the line now.
reaction: Satisfying to turn local material into a practical cover, though the result is straightforward.
reason: The covers and exterior line are ready to be joined to finish the protection.
expectation: The line will receive removable ceramic covers and the water-line goal may be complete.

effect: The water-line goal is complete; I can turn to the growing equipment and seed stock.
reaction: The quick installation is reassuring, although I would have liked a little detail about how the cover helps.
reason: Rinsing the used potato trough seems a natural first step toward leaving clean equipment.
expectation: The water will wash out the trough, perhaps before sterilization.

alternatives.reason: The seed crate also addresses the remaining goal, but I chose to clean the trough first.

effect: The trough is rinsed and the sterilizer is now offered, matching the cleaning plan.
reaction: This is predictable housekeeping, with a clear purpose.
reason: Sterilizing the rinsed trough should prepare it for future growing.
expectation: The sterilizer will produce a clean trough ready for another season.

effect: The trough is clean and ready to refill; the seed stock remains to be stored.
reaction: Nothing unexpected, but it feels sensible to leave the equipment ready.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and putting selected seed potatoes in a vented crate fits the remaining goal.
expectation: The potatoes will be stored as seed for the next season and the goal may complete.

effect: The stored seed completes the remaining goal and the chapter.
reaction: It gives a tidy sense of leaving the garden ready, though there is no detail about the storage conditions.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making and fitting the ceramic covers was most worthwhile: it turned local material into a practical improvement to a system that had needed attention during the storm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Rinsing and sterilizing the trough felt like routine housekeeping; the steps were clear but gave little further detail or discovery.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; the results followed the obvious purposes of the combinations.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless. I understood why the line needed a cover and why the trough and seeds needed preparation, although I wanted more detail about the cover and storage.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see what happens to the discovery and return journey, though this chapter itself was quiet and mechanically predictable.
